description: This file provides exception and interrupt context helper functions for Cortex-M CPUs, including functions to determine ISR status, nested exception state, and setup/clear system exceptions.

methods.name: arch_is_in_isr
methods.description: Checks if the current context is an ISR by inspecting the IPSR register.

methods.name: arch_is_in_nested_exception
methods.description: Determines if the processor was in handler mode before the current exception, based on the ESF.

methods.name: z_arm_preempted_thread_in_user_mode
methods.description: Checks if the current thread was in unprivileged mode.

methods.name: z_arm_exc_setup
methods.description: Sets up system exception priorities and enables fault exceptions.

methods.name: z_arm_clear_faults
methods.description: Clears fault status registers for memory, bus, usage, and hard faults.

methods.name: z_arm_debug_monitor_event_error_check
methods.description: Evaluates if a debug monitor exception should be treated as an error.
